_comment: Source and license registry for the Storilex dictionaries (Task 5C). Every value here was checked on 2026-11-22; see docs/lexicon_provenance/LICENSE_AUDIT.md for the evidence. Nothing here is legal advice. A source is only as good as its weakest field: an empty version, an unverified licence or an unknown data origin keeps its records out of 'approved'.

policy.bundle_license_note: Settings > Privacy and licenses says the dictionary database is shared under CC BY-SA 4.0 (lib/ui/settings_page.dart). The gate checks every record against this target.

GFDL-1.1-or-later.name: GNU Free Documentation License 1.1 or later

GPL-2.0-or-later.name: GNU General Public License 2.0 or later

Storilex-contrib.name: Storilex contributors, released by the project owner under the bundle licence

AI-output.name: Machine output: no licence grant, only the provider's terms of service

wiktionary_en.name: English Wiktionary
wiktionary_en.version_note: Taken through kaikki.org dumps that are downloaded without a date or hash (wiktionary.yml, tr-en-data.yml) and through the Kindle compilation (kaikki dump of May 2026 according to its README).
wiktionary_en.license_evidence: Wiktionary:Copyrights (read 2026-11-22): dual-licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL 1.1 or later; the page calls itself a draft proposal.
wiktionary_en.attribution: Contains material from English Wiktionary (https://en.wiktionary.org/), licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. Authors: Wiktionary contributors.

wiktionary_tr.name: Turkish Wiktionary (Vikisözlük)
wiktionary_tr.version_note: kaikki.org trwiktionary raw dump, downloaded without a date or hash (wiktionary.yml).
wiktionary_tr.license_evidence: Not read in this audit (tr.wiktionary.org was not reachable from the build machine). The app states CC BY-SA 4.0.
wiktionary_tr.attribution: Contains material from Turkish Wiktionary (https://tr.wiktionary.org/), Vikisözlük contributors.

kaikki.name: kaikki.org / wiktextract, English and Turkish Wiktionary (expressions)
kaikki.license_evidence: wiktextract code is MIT (LICENSE read); the data keeps the Wiktionary licence. kaikki.org itself was not reachable (Task 5A).

kindle_en_tr_wiktionary_part.name: Kindle English-Turkish dictionary by Murat Uysal, Wiktionary paragraphs only
kindle_en_tr_wiktionary_part.version_note: The .mobi release used by tools/main_meanings.py extract is not recorded (no tag, date or hash). The repository README describes a kaikki dump of May 2026.
kindle_en_tr_wiktionary_part.license_evidence: README: build code MIT, the combined .mobi GPL v2.0+ 'inherited from FreeDict'. build.py writes FreeDict blocks without a part-of-speech label; main_meanings.extract keeps only paragraphs that start with one, so the FreeDict part is left out by construction. Whether a CC BY-SA subset taken from a GPL-labelled compilation keeps CC BY-SA needs legal confirmation.
kindle_en_tr_wiktionary_part.attribution: Word meanings compiled by Murat Uysal (muratuysal.com) from English Wiktionary via kaikki.org.

damdafayton.name: damdafayton/eng-tur-dictionary
damdafayton.version_note: Last commit of the repository; the commit used when tools/data/main_meanings.jsonl.gz was made is not recorded.
damdafayton.license_evidence: README says 'This project is MIT licensed' and links ./MIT.md, which does not exist (404 on main and master; no LICENSE, LICENSE.md or COPYING file; checked by cloning on 2026-11-22). dict_base.py builds the database from a spreadsheet called lugat1.xls whose origin is not given anywhere.

freedict_eng_tur.name: FreeDict English-Turkish
freedict_eng_tur.license_evidence: eng-tur.tei header: edition 0.3, 'Copyright (C) 1999-2017 by various authors', 'GNU General Public License ver. 2.0 and any later version'; source gtksozluk2 (linuxprogramlama.com).
freedict_eng_tur.attribution: FreeDict English-Turkish dictionary 0.3, (C) 1999-2017 various authors (gtksozluk2), GPL-2.0-or-later.

princeton_wordnet.name: Princeton WordNet 3.0
princeton_wordnet.license_evidence: LICENSE file shipped with WordNet 3.0 (nltk_data wordnet.zip): permission to use, copy, modify and distribute for any purpose, with the copyright notice in all copies.
princeton_wordnet.attribution: WordNet 3.0 Copyright 2006 by Princeton University. All rights reserved. (full notice: wordnet.princeton.edu/license-and-commercial-use)

kenet.name: KeNet Turkish WordNet (Starlang / Özyeğin University)
kenet.version_note: dictionary-data.yml downloads kenet.xml from the master branch without a commit or hash. This audit used master as of 2026-11-22 (kenet.xml sha256 4023b4f8...).
kenet.license_evidence: README 'Licensing' section (added 2026-10-05, commit 0a0ba22): XML data files under CC BY-SA 4.0, code under GPL-3.0. Before that date the only licence file was GPL-3.0 (since 2021).
kenet.attribution: KeNet Turkish WordNet, Starlang Software / Özyeğin University (Olcay Taner Yıldız et al.), CC BY-SA 4.0.

cili.name: Collaborative Interlingual Index
cili.version_note: Downloaded from master without a commit.
cili.license_evidence: LICENSE: 'licensed under CC BY 4.0 or any later version', Francis Bond.
cili.attribution: Collaborative Interlingual Index, Francis Bond et al., CC BY 4.0.

tatoeba.name: Tatoeba
tatoeba.version_note: Weekly exports downloaded without a date (dictionary-data.yml, tr-en-data.yml).
tatoeba.license_evidence: Terms of use (effective 2022-04-24): CC BY 2.0 FR by default; each sentence can carry its own licence (CC0 allowed; ND, SA and non-marketing conditions exist); author must be named. The licence and author of each sentence are not stored in the Storilex databases.
tatoeba.attribution: Example sentences from Tatoeba (https://tatoeba.org), by Tatoeba contributors, CC BY 2.0 FR.

frequencywords.name: FrequencyWords (hermitdave), OpenSubtitles 2018
frequencywords.license_evidence: Repository code MIT (Task 5A); the app and tr_en.db meta say CC BY-SA 4.0 for the word lists, which this audit could not confirm. Only a rank number is used.
frequencywords.attribution: Word frequency: FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave, from OpenSubtitles 2018 (opensubtitles.org).

opensubtitles.name: OpenSubtitles 2018 (OPUS)
opensubtitles.license_evidence: OPUS names no licence, only an attribution request (Task 5A).

storilex_contrib.name: Storilex contributors (hand-checked sheets, tools/contrib)
storilex_contrib.license_evidence: Written and checked by the project owner (Hamit). The owner should confirm in writing that rows were not copied from closed dictionaries.

storilex_categories.name: Storilex category lists (tools/categories.py)
storilex_categories.license_evidence: File header: 'Written for this project; released with the app under CC BY-SA 4.0'. git log: 4 commits by Claude, 2 by the owner. The lists were written with an AI assistant; no record of a human review.

storilex_expr_fixes.name: Storilex expression fixes (tools/expr_fixes.py)
storilex_expr_fixes.license_evidence: In-repository corrections; authored in commits by Claude and the owner.

ai_pretranslate.name: AI drafts from tools/pretranslate.py (Gemini, Mistral, Groq, Cerebras, OpenRouter; Claude for tools/data)
ai_pretranslate.version_note: Model names and dates are in the release data files, not in dict.db.
ai_pretranslate.license_evidence: No licence; each provider's terms decide. The NVIDIA trial was excluded because its terms forbid publishing (dictionary-data.yml comment).

own_dict_ai.name: Storilex own dictionary drafts (own_word / own_expr, source=ai_generated)
own_dict_ai.license_evidence: Status ai_draft_unreviewed, reviewed=0 in dict.db. Model and prompt not stored per row.

dbnary.name: DBnary
dbnary.license_evidence: Not used in the databases; listed for the lineage check (Task 5A).

babelnet.name: BabelNet
babelnet.license_evidence: BabelNet Non-Commercial licence, research institutions only (Task 5A). Not used.

kaikki_en.name: kaikki.org / wiktextract, English Wiktionary
kaikki_en.license_evidence: wiktextract code is MIT (LICENSE read); the data keeps the Wiktionary licence. kaikki.org itself was not reachable (Task 5A).
